title: genai-synthetic-netsec
summary: A course project pipeline that generates privacy-preserving synthetic network traffic data from the UNSW-NB15 dataset, evaluating it across fidelity, utility, and privacy axes and using synthesis to augment rare attack classes. It trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with SDV Metadata and evaluates results via sdv.evaluation.single_table (evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic) and sdmetrics (KSComplement, TVComplement, NewRowSynthesis).
